name: gpu_hot_status
description: Check the dedicated GPU helper host used for local GPU inference. Returns NVIDIA GPU utilization, allocated VRAM, temperature, power, GPU processes, and host CPU/RAM/load. Use for 'how is Mini AI doing?', 'check the GPU host', 'how much VRAM is loaded?', 'what is using the GPU?', or 'is the local inference machine overloaded?'. This is the remote GPU helper; use system_monitor for the machine running Jarvis itself. Omit base_url to use the configured dashboard.

base_url.description: Optional GPU Hot dashboard base URL, such as http://gpu-host:1312. Omit to use the configured dashboard URL.

host_label.description: Optional friendly host label for the response. Defaults to the configured host label or Mini AI.

include_host.description: When true (default), read one WebSocket snapshot for host CPU/RAM and GPU processes. Falls back to GPU-only REST metrics if needed.

max_processes.description: Maximum GPU processes to return, ordered by VRAM usage. Range 0-25; default 10.

timeout_seconds.description: Network timeout in seconds. Range 1-15; default 8.
